columns.label: Overall
columns.help: Surface, geometry and appearance, mixed. Zero is the bounding box at the measured height; one is perfect.

columns.label: Repeat SD
columns.help: How far the same model moves when the same building is run again. Measured on this model's own repeated cells; blank when nobody has repeated it, which is not the same as zero.

columns.label: Runs
columns.help: How many runs went into this row, across the cells it is ranked on. More than one per cell is a repeat.

columns.label: Surface F
columns.help: Agreement between two point clouds at half a metre.

columns.label: Cost / run
columns.help: Median of what one run of this model cost.

columns.label: Buildings
columns.help: How many buildings this row is a mean over. Rows do not all have the same number, and buildings differ, so two rows are two measurements; the column beside puts them on the same set.

columns.label: On the shared set
columns.help: The same model over the buildings EVERY row has run, for a like-for-like reading. Blank where this model has not run all of them.
